title: AI is turning B2B outreach into a tragedy of the commons

content_html:
AI did not make buyers easier to reach. It made everyone cheaper to interrupt.

A modern AI sales agent can research a company, identify a plausible buying signal, compose a personalised email, schedule follow-ups, evaluate the response, and hand a qualified opportunity to a human salesperson.

Major CRM vendors now market agents that research leads, draft and send personalised outreach, and follow up with limited human supervision. Microsoft describes an autonomous sales qualification agent that can qualify leads at scale, while HubSpot offers a prospecting agent for automated research and outreach. This is no longer a speculative feature of the sales stack. It is becoming normal infrastructure.

For an individual company, the economics are compelling. Work that previously required hours of human research and writing can now be completed in seconds. The rational response is to contact more prospects.

But when every company follows the same logic, the collective result is not more relevance. It is more interruptions.

B2B outreach is becoming a tragedy of the commons.

The shared resource is not the inbox

In the traditional tragedy of the commons, individuals acting in their own interest gradually exhaust a resource shared by everyone.

In outbound sales, that shared resource is not email itself. Email is effectively unlimited. The scarce resources are buyer attention, channel trust, and sender reputation.

Every unsolicited message consumes a small amount of each. A useful message may repay that cost by helping the recipient discover a relevant solution. An irrelevant message makes a withdrawal without creating value in return.

No individual sender owns the recipient’s attention. No individual sender controls how mailbox providers respond to unwanted messages. Yet every sender has an incentive to consume a little more of both.

The damage initially looks manageable. Reply rates decline slightly. More messages land in spam. Buyers become less receptive to unfamiliar senders. Teams then respond by increasing volume.

That creates a cycle: lower production costs lead to more messages; more messages produce less attention per message; lower response rates encourage yet more volume; complaints and disengagement rise; mailbox providers tighten their filtering; and the channel becomes less effective for everyone.

I call this interruption inflation: when the supply of automated outreach grows faster than the supply of human attention, each message purchases less attention than the one before it.

The data shows a market under pressure

At Belkins, we see this market at considerable scale. For our 2025 cross-channel benchmark, Belkins and its research partners analysed 16.5 million cold emails, more than 20 million LinkedIn outreach attempts, and more than 5 million cold calls. The size of that dataset matters because the pressure is not limited to one campaign, industry, or channel.

A separate Belkins analysis of more than 7.5 million cold emails sent during 2025 used a strict methodology: replies were measured against all emails sent to net-new contacts, not only against recipients who opened an email.

The average reply rate was 0.45%. More importantly, the first half of 2025 averaged 0.50%, while the second half averaged 0.40%, a 20% decline within the same year. December reached a low of 0.35%.

This does not prove that AI caused the decline. Buyer behaviour, economic conditions, targeting quality, deliverability, seasonality, and messaging all affect performance. The newer study also uses a different denominator from previous Belkins research, so its absolute reply rate should not be directly compared with earlier reports.

What the data does show is that buyer response is not infinitely elastic. Increasing the supply of messages does not create a corresponding increase in buyer attention.

The infrastructure is also becoming less forgiving. Google advises bulk senders to keep their user-reported spam rate below 0.1% and prevent it from reaching 0.3% or higher. Rates above 0.1% can negatively affect inbox delivery, while rates of 0.3% or more have an even stronger effect.

Put differently, a spam rate of 0.1% represents roughly one complaint per 1,000 delivered messages. A rate of 0.3% represents three complaints per 1,000. That is not much room for error.

AI can generate thousands of convincing sentences, but a tiny number of recipients can still damage the sender’s ability to reach everyone else.

Personalisation is becoming a commodity

For years, the sales industry treated personalisation as the solution to poor outreach. The basic idea was reasonable: research the recipient, mention something specific, and demonstrate that the message was written for them.

AI is rapidly making surface-level personalisation a commodity. Almost any system can identify that a prospect recently raised funding, hired a senior executive, launched a product, appeared on a podcast, or published a LinkedIn post.

Once every sender has access to the same facts, mentioning those facts no longer proves that meaningful attention was invested. It merely proves that the sender has access to software.

Personalisation without selectivity is just better-targeted noise.

True relevance requires more than inserting personal details. The recipient must plausibly have the problem, the problem must matter now, the proposed solution must be credible, and the value of the message must justify the interruption.

AI can help evaluate those conditions. But most sales systems are still optimised around the wrong output. They measure how many personalised messages the machine can produce, rather than how many unnecessary messages it correctly decides not to send.

When everyone can manufacture the appearance of relevance, relevance stops being primarily a copywriting problem. It becomes a judgement problem.

Reputation is now part of the product

We learned this lesson before the current AI sales boom. In 2019, Folderly began as an internal solution after recurring deliverability problems began affecting outreach. The original purpose was to identify technical issues, improve inbox placement, and recover mailboxes that were being classified as spam.

The deeper lesson was not simply that companies needed another deliverability tool. It was that authentication, infrastructure, sender behaviour, reputation, targeting, and message quality form one connected system.

A perfectly written email creates no value when it does not reach the inbox. At the same time, no technical deliverability system can transform an unwanted message into a wanted one.

Reputation is partly technical, but it is also behavioural. Every campaign teaches mailbox providers and recipients how much trust to place in the next message.

That makes sender reputation a business asset rather than a technical afterthought.

The next sales stack needs a trust budget

The future of outbound is not zero outbound. Buyers still benefit from discovering solutions they did not know existed, and new companies still need ways to reach markets that are unfamiliar with them.

But the next generation of sales systems must treat attention and trust as finite resources.

Use AI to reduce uncertainty before increasing activity

The system should gather stronger evidence that a company has the right problem, timing, and buying conditions before initiating contact. Better research should produce fewer weak messages, not merely more polished ones.

Give every account a contact budget

A prospect who has already received several unanswered messages should not be treated as an untouched opportunity simply because another department, channel, or agent owns the next sequence.

Coordinate channels around the buyer

An email, LinkedIn message, phone call, advertisement, and automated follow-up are not separate interactions from the buyer’s perspective. They are all withdrawals from the same attention account.

Measure negative externalities

Positive replies and meetings matter, but so do spam complaints, unsubscribes, negative replies, domain health, inbox placement, and the number of contacts repeatedly approached without engagement.

Keep human judgement closest to the interruption

AI is excellent at increasing the amount of context available to a salesperson. It is less reliable when asked to decide, without supervision, whether a commercially plausible message deserves a stranger’s attention.

Restraint will become a competitive advantage

AI will not kill outbound sales. Undisciplined use of AI might damage it.

The companies that win will not necessarily be those that generate the largest number of personalised messages. They will be the ones that develop the clearest understanding of who should be contacted, why the timing is justified, what value the interaction creates, and when silence is the better decision.

The most valuable action taken by an AI sales agent may eventually be a non-action: do not send this message.

When interruption becomes cheap, restraint becomes a competitive advantage.

sentences.zh: 换句话说，0.1% 的垃圾邮件率大约代表每 1,000 条已发送邮件中有 1 起投诉。

sentences.en: A rate of 0.3% represents three complaints per 1,000.
sentences.zh: 0.3% 的比率表示每 1,000 起投诉中有 3 起。

sentences.en: That is not much room for error.
sentences.zh: 这没有太大的犯错空间。

blocks.html_en: AI can generate thousands of convincing sentences, but a tiny number of recipients can still damage the sender’s ability to reach everyone else.

sentences.en: AI can generate thousands of convincing sentences, but a tiny number of recipients can still damage the sender’s ability to reach everyone else.
sentences.zh: 人工智能可以生成数千个令人信服的句子，但极少数的收件人仍然会损害发件人联系其他所有人的能力。

blocks.html_en: Personalisation is becoming a commodity

sentences.en: Personalisation is becoming a commodity
sentences.zh: 个性化正在成为一种商品

blocks.html_en: For years, the sales industry treated personalisation as the solution to poor outreach. The basic idea was reasonable: research the recipient, mention something specific, and demonstrate that the message was written for them.

sentences.en: For years, the sales industry treated personalisation as the solution to poor outreach.
sentences.zh: 多年来，销售行业一直将个性化视为解决推广效果不佳的方法。

sentences.en: The basic idea was reasonable: research the recipient, mention something specific, and demonstrate that the message was written for them.
sentences.zh: 基本想法是合理的：研究收件人，提及特定的内容，并证明该消息是为他们写的。

blocks.html_en: AI is rapidly making surface-level personalisation a commodity. Almost any system can identify that a prospect recently raised funding, hired a senior executive, launched a product, appeared on a podcast, or published a LinkedIn post.

sentences.en: AI is rapidly making surface-level personalisation a commodity.
sentences.zh: 人工智能正在迅速使表面个性化成为一种商品。

sentences.en: Almost any system can identify that a prospect recently raised funding, hired a senior executive, launched a product, appeared on a podcast, or published a LinkedIn post.
sentences.zh: 几乎任何系统都可以识别潜在客户最近筹集了资金、聘请了高级管理人员、推出了产品、出现在播客上或发布了 LinkedIn 帖子。

blocks.html_en: Once every sender has access to the same facts, mentioning those facts no longer proves that meaningful attention was invested. It merely proves that the sender has access to software.

sentences.en: Once every sender has access to the same facts, mentioning those facts no longer proves that meaningful attention was invested.
sentences.zh: 一旦每个发送者都可以访问相同的事实，提及这些事实就不再证明他们投入了有意义的注意力。

sentences.en: It merely proves that the sender has access to software.
sentences.zh: 它仅证明发送者可以访问软件。

blocks.html_en: Personalisation without selectivity is just better-targeted noise.

sentences.en: Personalisation without selectivity is just better-targeted noise.
sentences.zh: 没有选择性的个性化只是更有针对性的噪音。

blocks.html_en: Personalisation without selectivity is just better-targeted noise.

sentences.en: Personalisation without selectivity is just better-targeted noise.
sentences.zh: 没有选择性的个性化只是更有针对性的噪音。

blocks.html_en: True relevance requires more than inserting personal details. The recipient must plausibly have the problem, the problem must matter now, the proposed solution must be credible, and the value of the message must justify the interruption.

sentences.en: True relevance requires more than inserting personal details.
sentences.zh: 真正的相关性需要的不仅仅是插入个人详细信息。

sentences.en: The recipient must plausibly have the problem, the problem must matter now, the proposed solution must be credible, and the value of the message must justify the interruption.
sentences.zh: 接收者必须貌似有问题，问题现在必须很重要，提出的解决方案必须可信，并且消息的价值必须证明中断是合理的。

blocks.html_en: AI can help evaluate those conditions. But most sales systems are still optimised around the wrong output. They measure how many personalised messages the machine can produce, rather than how many unnecessary messages it correctly decides not to send.

sentences.en: AI can help evaluate those conditions.

sentences.en: But most sales systems are still optimised around the wrong output.

sentences.en: They measure how many personalised messages the machine can produce, rather than how many unnecessary messages it correctly decides not to send.
sentences.zh: 他们测量机器可以生成多少条个性化消息，而不是它正确决定不发送多少条不必要的消息。

blocks.html_en: When everyone can manufacture the appearance of relevance, relevance stops being primarily a copywriting problem. It becomes a judgement problem.

sentences.en: When everyone can manufacture the appearance of relevance, relevance stops being primarily a copywriting problem.
sentences.zh: 当每个人都可以制造出相关性的外观时，相关性就不再是主要的文案问题。

sentences.en: It becomes a judgement problem.

blocks.html_en: Reputation is now part of the product

sentences.en: Reputation is now part of the product
sentences.zh: 声誉现在已成为产品的一部分

blocks.html_en: We learned this lesson before the current AI sales boom. In 2019, Folderly began as an internal solution after recurring deliverability problems began affecting outreach. The original purpose was to identify technical issues, improve inbox placement, and recover mailboxes that were being classified as spam.

sentences.en: We learned this lesson before the current AI sales boom.

sentences.zh: 2019 年，在反复出现的交付能力问题开始影响外展后，Folderly 开始作为内部解决方案。

blocks.html_en: The deeper lesson was not simply that companies needed another deliverability tool. It was that authentication, infrastructure, sender behaviour, reputation, targeting, and message quality form one connected system.

sentences.zh: 身份验证、基础设施、发送者行为、声誉、目标定位和消息质量形成一个互联系统。

blocks.html_en: A perfectly written email creates no value when it does not reach the inbox. At the same time, no technical deliverability system can transform an unwanted message into a wanted one.

sentences.en: A perfectly written email creates no value when it does not reach the inbox.

sentences.zh: 与此同时，没有任何技术传递系统可以将不需要的消息转换为想要的消息。

blocks.html_en: Reputation is partly technical, but it is also behavioural. Every campaign teaches mailbox providers and recipients how much trust to place in the next message.

sentences.en: Reputation is partly technical, but it is also behavioural.
sentences.zh: 声誉部分是技术性的，但也是行为性的。

sentences.zh: 每一次活动都会教会邮箱提供商和收件人对下一封邮件的信任程度。

blocks.html_en: That makes sender reputation a business asset rather than a technical afterthought.

sentences.en: That makes sender reputation a business asset rather than a technical afterthought.
sentences.zh: 这使得发件人声誉成为一种商业资产，而不是技术上的事后想法。

blocks.html_en: The next sales stack needs a trust budget

sentences.en: The next sales stack needs a trust budget

blocks.html_en: The future of outbound is not zero outbound. Buyers still benefit from discovering solutions they did not know existed, and new companies still need ways to reach markets that are unfamiliar with them.

sentences.en: Buyers still benefit from discovering solutions they did not know existed, and new companies still need ways to reach markets that are unfamiliar with them.

blocks.html_en: But the next generation of sales systems must treat attention and trust as finite resources.

sentences.en: But the next generation of sales systems must treat attention and trust as finite resources.
sentences.zh: 但下一代销售系统必须将注意力和信任视为有限资源。

sentences.en: Use AI to reduce uncertainty before increasing activity

blocks.html_en: The system should gather stronger evidence that a company has the right problem, timing, and buying conditions before initiating contact. Better research should produce fewer weak messages, not merely more polished ones.

sentences.en: The system should gather stronger evidence that a company has the right problem, timing, and buying conditions before initiating contact.
sentences.zh: 在开始联系之前，系统应该收集更有力的证据，证明公司有正确的问题、时机和购买条件。

sentences.en: Better research should produce fewer weak messages, not merely more polished ones.
sentences.zh: 更好的研究应该产生更少的弱信息，而不仅仅是更精致的信息。

blocks.html_en: Give every account a contact budget

sentences.en: Give every account a contact budget
sentences.zh: 为每个帐户提供联系预算

blocks.html_en: A prospect who has already received several unanswered messages should not be treated as an untouched opportunity simply because another department, channel, or agent owns the next sequence.

sentences.en: A prospect who has already received several unanswered messages should not be treated as an untouched opportunity simply because another department, channel, or agent owns the next sequence.
sentences.zh: 已经收到多条未回复消息的潜在客户不应仅仅因为另一个部门、渠道或代理拥有下一个序列而将其视为未触及的机会。

blocks.html_en: Coordinate channels around the buyer

sentences.en: Coordinate channels around the buyer
sentences.zh: 协调买家周围的渠道

blocks.html_en: An email, LinkedIn message, phone call, advertisement, and automated follow-up are not separate interactions from the buyer’s perspective. They are all withdrawals from the same attention account.

sentences.en: An email, LinkedIn message, phone call, advertisement, and automated follow-up are not separate interactions from the buyer’s perspective.
sentences.zh: 从买家的角度来看，电子邮件、LinkedIn 消息、电话、广告和自动跟进并不是单独的交互。

sentences.en: They are all withdrawals from the same attention account.
sentences.zh: 都是从同一个关注账户提现。

blocks.html_en: Measure negative externalities

sentences.en: Measure negative externalities
sentences.zh: 衡量负外部性

blocks.html_en: Positive replies and meetings matter, but so do spam complaints, unsubscribes, negative replies, domain health, inbox placement, and the number of contacts repeatedly approached without engagement.

sentences.en: Positive replies and meetings matter, but so do spam complaints, unsubscribes, negative replies, domain health, inbox placement, and the number of contacts repeatedly approached without engagement.
sentences.zh: 积极的回复和会议很重要，但垃圾邮件投诉、取消订阅、消极回复、域名健康状况、收件箱放置以及反复接触但未参与的联系人数量也很重要。

blocks.html_en: Keep human judgement closest to the interruption

sentences.en: Keep human judgement closest to the interruption
sentences.zh: 让人类的判断最接近中断

blocks.html_en: AI is excellent at increasing the amount of context available to a salesperson. It is less reliable when asked to decide, without supervision, whether a commercially plausible message deserves a stranger’s attention.

sentences.en: AI is excellent at increasing the amount of context available to a salesperson.
sentences.zh: 人工智能在增加销售人员可用的上下文数量方面表现出色。

sentences.en: It is less reliable when asked to decide, without supervision, whether a commercially plausible message deserves a stranger’s attention.
sentences.zh: 当被要求在没有监督的情况下决定一条商业上合理的消息是否值得陌生人关注时，它的可靠性就不那么高了。

blocks.html_en: Restraint will become a competitive advantage

sentences.en: Restraint will become a competitive advantage
sentences.zh: 克制将成为竞争优势

blocks.html_en: AI will not kill outbound sales. Undisciplined use of AI might damage it.

sentences.en: AI will not kill outbound sales.
sentences.zh: 人工智能不会扼杀对外销售。

blocks.html_en: The companies that win will not necessarily be those that generate the largest number of personalised messages. They will be the ones that develop the clearest understanding of who should be contacted, why the timing is justified, what value the interaction creates, and when silence is the better decision.

sentences.en: The companies that win will not necessarily be those that generate the largest number of personalised messages.
sentences.zh: 获胜的公司不一定是那些生成最多个性化消息的公司。

sentences.en: They will be the ones that develop the clearest understanding of who should be contacted, why the timing is justified, what value the interaction creates, and when silence is the better decision.
sentences.zh: 他们将最清楚地了解应该联系谁、为什么时机合理、互动创造什么价值以及何时沉默是更好的决定。

blocks.html_en: The most valuable action taken by an AI sales agent may eventually be a non-action: do not send this message.

sentences.en: The most valuable action taken by an AI sales agent may eventually be a non-action: do not send this message.
sentences.zh: 人工智能销售代理采取的最有价值的行动最终可能是不采取行动：不发送此消息。

blocks.html_en: The most valuable action taken by an AI sales agent may eventually be a non-action: do not send this message.

sentences.en: The most valuable action taken by an AI sales agent may eventually be a non-action: do not send this message.
sentences.zh: 人工智能销售代理采取的最有价值的行动最终可能是不采取行动：不发送此消息。

blocks.html_en: When interruption becomes cheap, restraint becomes a competitive advantage.

sentences.en: When interruption becomes cheap, restraint becomes a competitive advantage.
sentences.zh: 当打扰变得便宜时，克制就成为一种竞争优势。

content_html_zh:
人工智能并没有让买家更容易接触到。 这让每个人都更容易打断。

现代人工智能销售代理可以研究公司，识别合理的购买信号，撰写个性化电子邮件，安排后续行动，评估响应，并将合格的机会交给人类销售人员。

主要的 CRM 供应商现在销售的代理商负责研究线索、起草和发送个性化宣传，并在有限的人工监督下进行跟进。 Microsoft 描述了一种可以大规模鉴定销售线索的自主销售资格代理，而 HubSpot 则提供了用于自动化研究和推广的勘探代理。 这不再是销售堆栈的投机特征。 它正在成为正常的基础设施。

对于单个公司来说，经济效益是引人注目的。 以前需要数小时的人类研究和写作的工作现在可以在几秒钟内完成。 理性的反应是联系更多的潜在客户。

但当每家公司都遵循相同的逻辑时，集体结果并不会更具相关性。 这是更多的干扰。

B2B 外展正在成为一场公地悲剧。

共享资源不是收件箱

在传统的公地悲剧中，个人为了自身利益而行动，逐渐耗尽所有人共享的资源。

在对外销售中，共享资源不是电子邮件本身。 电子邮件实际上是无限的。 稀缺资源是买家关注度、渠道信任度和发件人声誉。

每条未经请求的消息都会消耗少量的信息。 有用的消息可以通过帮助接收者发现相关的解决方案来补偿这一成本。 一条不相关的消息会导致提款，但不会创造价值作为回报。

没有哪个发件人能引起收件人的注意。 没有哪个发件人可以控制邮箱提供商如何响应不需要的邮件。 然而，每个发送者都有动力多消费一点这两种东西。

损害最初看起来是可以控制的。 回复率略有下降。 更多邮件进入垃圾邮件。 买家对不熟悉的发件人的接受度降低。 然后团队通过增加音量来做出反应。

这就形成了一个循环：较低的生产成本导致更多的消息；消息越多，每条消息的关注度就越低；较低的回复率会鼓励更多的数量；投诉和脱离接触增加；邮箱提供商加强过滤；并且该渠道对每个人来说都变得不那么有效。

我将这种现象称为“中断通货膨胀”：当自动外联的供应量增长速度快于人类注意力的供应量时，每条消息所获得的关注度都会比前一条消息少。

数据显示市场面临压力

在贝尔金斯，我们看到这个市场规模相当大。 对于我们的 2025 年跨渠道基准，贝尔金斯及其研究合作伙伴分析了 1650 万封冷电子邮件、超过 2000 万次 LinkedIn 外展尝试以及超过 500 万个冷电话。 该数据集的大小很重要，因为压力并不局限于某一活动、行业或渠道。

贝尔金斯对 2025 年发送的超过 750 万封冷电子邮件进行了单独的分析，使用了严格的方法：根据发送给新联系人的所有电子邮件来衡量回复，而不仅仅是针对打开电子邮件的收件人。

平均回复率为0.45%。 更重要的是，2025年上半年平均为0.50%，下半年平均为0.40%，同年下降了20%。 12 月跌至 0.35% 的低点。

这并不能证明人工智能导致了衰退。 买家行为、经济状况、定位质量、交付能力、季节性和信息传递都会影响绩效。 这项新研究还使用了与之前贝尔金斯研究不同的分母，因此其绝对答复率不应与早期报告直接比较。

数据确实表明买家的反应并不是无限弹性的。 增加消息的供应并不会相应增加买家的注意力。

基础设施也变得越来越不宽容。 Google 建议批量发件人将用户报告的垃圾邮件率控制在 0.1% 以下，并防止其达到 0.3% 或更高。 高于 0.1% 的费率会对收件箱递送产生负面影响，而 0.3% 或更高的费率影响更大。

换句话说，0.1% 的垃圾邮件率大约代表每 1,000 条已发送邮件中有 1 起投诉。 0.3% 的比率表示每 1,000 起投诉中有 3 起。 这没有太大的犯错空间。

人工智能可以生成数千个令人信服的句子，但极少数的收件人仍然会损害发件人联系其他所有人的能力。

个性化正在成为一种商品

多年来，销售行业一直将个性化视为解决推广效果不佳的方法。 基本想法是合理的：研究收件人，提及特定的内容，并证明该消息是为他们写的。

人工智能正在迅速使表面个性化成为一种商品。 几乎任何系统都可以识别潜在客户最近筹集了资金、聘请了高级管理人员、推出了产品、出现在播客上或发布了 LinkedIn 帖子。

一旦每个发送者都可以访问相同的事实，提及这些事实就不再证明他们投入了有意义的注意力。 它仅证明发送者可以访问软件。

没有选择性的个性化只是更有针对性的噪音。

真正的相关性需要的不仅仅是插入个人详细信息。 接收者必须貌似有问题，问题现在必须很重要，提出的解决方案必须可信，并且消息的价值必须证明中断是合理的。

人工智能可以帮助评估这些条件。 但大多数销售系统仍然围绕错误的输出进行优化。 他们测量机器可以生成多少条个性化消息，而不是它正确决定不发送多少条不必要的消息。

当每个人都可以制造出相关性的外观时，相关性就不再是主要的文案问题。 这就变成了一个判断问题。

声誉现在已成为产品的一部分

我们在当前的人工智能销售热潮之前就吸取了这一教训。 2019 年，在反复出现的交付能力问题开始影响外展后，Folderly 开始作为内部解决方案。 最初的目的是识别技术问题、改善收件箱放置并恢复被归类为垃圾邮件的邮箱。

更深层次的教训不仅仅是公司需要另一种交付工具。 身份验证、基础设施、发送者行为、声誉、目标定位和消息质量形成一个互联系统。

一封写得很完美的电子邮件如果没有到达收件箱，就没有任何价值。 与此同时，没有任何技术传递系统可以将不需要的消息转换为想要的消息。

声誉部分是技术性的，但也是行为性的。 每一次活动都会教会邮箱提供商和收件人对下一封邮件的信任程度。

这使得发件人声誉成为一种商业资产，而不是技术上的事后想法。

下一个销售堆栈需要信任预算

未来的出境不是零出境。 买家仍然会从发现他们不知道的解决方案中受益，而新公司仍然需要找到方法来进入他们不熟悉的市场。

但下一代销售系统必须将注意力和信任视为有限资源。

在增加活动之前使用人工智能减少不确定性

在开始联系之前，系统应该收集更有力的证据，证明公司有正确的问题、时机和购买条件。 更好的研究应该产生更少的弱信息，而不仅仅是更精致的信息。

为每个帐户提供联系预算

已经收到多条未回复消息的潜在客户不应仅仅因为另一个部门、渠道或代理拥有下一个序列而将其视为未触及的机会。

协调买家周围的渠道

从买家的角度来看，电子邮件、LinkedIn 消息、电话、广告和自动跟进并不是单独的交互。 都是从同一个关注账户提现。

衡量负外部性

积极的回复和会议很重要，但垃圾邮件投诉、取消订阅、消极回复、域名健康状况、收件箱放置以及反复接触但未参与的联系人数量也很重要。

让人类的判断最接近中断

人工智能在增加销售人员可用的上下文数量方面表现出色。 当被要求在没有监督的情况下决定一条商业上合理的消息是否值得陌生人关注时，它的可靠性就不那么高了。

克制将成为竞争优势

人工智能不会扼杀对外销售。 不规范地使用人工智能可能会对其造成损害。

获胜的公司不一定是那些生成最多个性化消息的公司。 他们将最清楚地了解应该联系谁、为什么时机合理、互动创造什么价值以及何时沉默是更好的决定。

人工智能销售代理采取的最有价值的行动最终可能是不采取行动：不发送此消息。

当打扰变得便宜时，克制就成为一种竞争优势。
